main_topics: impact on work and family life
output.reason_for_conversation: understanding disease control and next treatment steps
output.summary: User with ulcerative colitis described severe urgency (6-7 times daily, sometimes more) with occasional bleeding, stating a general doctor had dismissed it as normal. The bot validated the symptoms as signs of undertreated disease, explained that remission is achievable, and educated the user on stepped treatment options (rectal mesalamine, steroids, immunomodulators, biologics), the fecal calprotectin test, strategies to expedite specialist referral, and practical coping measures. The user felt empowered by the end, confirmed understanding of a concrete plan, and expressed gratitude.
